method: deterministic candidate-time rules; no guard API calls

gates.pilot_control: at least one isolated real conflict blocked and a real allowed operation with no observed false block
gates.synthetic_control: matched alternative remains unblocked; ambiguous control remains unblocked
gates.live_pilot: verify no simulator submission on block; monitor capability is independent of formal task gains

feature_source: checkpoint visible history, user update, earlier visible responses, validated intent and candidate parameters only
isolation: separate predictor process with feature-file-only interface; labels joined by a distinct process; no OS-level sandbox
single_repair: Do not count a negated intent clause as an affirmative retained action. Still veto checks if an affirmative replacement uses the same action.
